subject: Login failure - invalid password error
ticketText: I've been trying to log into my account for the past hour. Every time I enter my password, I get an 'Invalid credentials' error, even after resetting it twice. I'm locked out of a client presentation that starts in 20 minutes.

expected.nextAction: Verify the account isn't locked from repeated failed attempts, force a password reset, and confirm MFA settings are not blocking login.

subject: Duplicate charge on October invoice
ticketText: Our finance team flagged that invoice #INV-10456 was charged twice to our corporate card on the same day. Both charges show the identical invoice number and amount ($2,450.00). We need one of them reversed immediately.

expected.nextAction: Confirm the duplicate charge in the payment processor, issue a refund for the second charge, and flag the billing run that caused it.

subject: Dashboard completely down for all users
ticketText: Everything is broken. Every user in our organization is getting a blank white screen when they try to load the dashboard. This has been going on for over 30 minutes and we have no ETA.

expected.nextAction: Page the on-call engineer, check recent deploys for a regression, and post a status page update within 10 minutes.
